title: chore: Split cypress tests locally
body:

Avoids the dependency on the cypress server, so tests from forks can also run in parallel.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
@github doesn't recommend starting cron schedules on the hour.

Instead, we should pick an offset after the hour starts, so there's a lower risk of the job getting dropped/delayed: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#schedule

```suggestion
    - cron: '28 3 * * *'
```
